steps.name: confirm-inventory-command-contract
steps.summary: ConfirmInventoryCommand contract, InventoryConfirmedEvent messaging/topic mapping, handler export, confirm outbox payload metadata, and reservation confirm idempotency/rejection tests were added and verified.

steps.name: approval-to-inventory-confirm-wiring
steps.summary: CheckoutProcessManager now emits deterministic ConfirmInventoryCommand for OrderApprovedEvent while preserving release/refund/cancel compensation for rejection, payment failure, and payment expiration; sequence docs were updated.

steps.name: inventory-listener-runtime-wiring
steps.summary: InventoryKafkaCommandListener now deserializes and dispatches ConfirmInventoryCommand, topic resolver maps confirm command/event topics, and live worker registry preview includes the inventory command listener without starting broker loops.

steps.name: inventory-idempotency-observability
steps.summary: Inventory reserve/confirm/release idempotency and observability payloads now preserve stock counters, reservation status, correlationId, causationId, and PostgreSQL reservation status roundtrips.

steps.name: inventory-saga-public-verification
steps.summary: Public docs and README now describe reserve/release/confirm saga behavior, ConfirmInventoryCommand remains internal to message listeners with no public HTTP route, and phase metadata reflects completion.
